facts.fact: SUNA reports the Ministries of Health and Digital Transformation launched on 2026-05-11 phase one of the HMS hospital-management programme, whose integrated systems include a civil registration and vital statistics (CRVS) system, starting at Al-Nao hospital in Khartoum State and the diagnostic centre at Gedaref hospital.
